Hi! Non-Jewish wife of a Jewish Israeli man, we live in Haifa in a dominantly secular Jewish area.
We have a 5yo boy who is not circumcised, and a 2yo girl: no discrimination, not even in the slightest 😅 we openly celebrate Christmas and Jewish holidays, and it's very obvious the kids are culturally Jewish without being officially Jewish.
Nobody cares 🌈

And you really shouldn't be forced into a conversion! I hope your partner is supportive 💚
